description: This Java class 'ShippingMethodsController' is a Spring MVC controller that manages HTTP requests related to shipping methods in an e-commerce application. It provides methods for displaying available shipping methods, configuring individual shipping methods, saving configurations, and deleting shipping modules. The class interacts with services to retrieve and update shipping configurations and defines routes for administrator actions related to shipping modules.

classes.name: ShippingMethodsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller class for managing shipping methods configuration within the admin area of an e-commerce application.

methods.name: displayShippingMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of available shipping methods and their configurations.

methods.name: displayShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the configuration page for a specific shipping method identified by 'code'.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save/update the configuration of a shipping method.

methods.name: saveCustomWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a custom weight-based shipping configuration.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a shipping method configuration identified by 'code'.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up the menu context for the view.
